latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Free — cloud-based, watermark-free video editing and export.
- Simple setup: authenticate instantly and start editing with no subscriptions or installs.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; export MP4 in 1080p by default.
- All common edit, preview, and export actions routed by natural language prompts.
- Free, fast turnaround: expect download links within 30-90 seconds for most clips.
- No watermarks, no hidden costs—ideal for creators who want quick, professional results.
